## ANSWER (names first, in case the key is names-only)

**The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD scenarios and ML Canvas.**

Everything below is my own computation. **I did not reproduce 10.13% / 4.366% and do not claim to.**

---

## Primary: Q10-complete base, N=194 (leading figure)

I lead with this base because it follows directly from the sentinel rule you approved — `-77` is a whole-block no-response (82 rows, all `Suspended`, zero partial skips), so it is removed from numerator *and* denominator, leaving 276 − 82 = 194. Respondent-level bootstrap, B=10,000, seed=42, ranking computed as a joint statistic per replicate.

| rank | format | k | % selecting | 95% bootstrap CI | Wilson CI | P(in two least used) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **BDD_Scenarios** | 4 | **2.062** | [0.515, 4.124] | [0.805, 5.181] | **100.00%** |
| 2 | **MLCanvas** | 15 | **7.732** | [4.124, 11.856] | [4.741, 12.364] | **97.55%** |
| 3 | Vision_Document | 29 | 14.948 | [10.309, 20.103] | [10.614, 20.644] | 1.44% |
| 3 | Goal_Models | 29 | 14.948 | [10.309, 20.103] | [10.614, 20.644] | 0.89% |
| 5 | Data_Models | 34 | 17.526 | [12.371, 23.196] | [12.821, 23.491] | 0.09% |
| 6 | Use_Case_Models | 38 | 19.588 | [14.433, 25.258] | [14.616, 25.740] | 0.03% |
| 7 | Prototypes | 42 | 21.649 | [15.979, 27.320] | [16.435, 27.965] | 0.00% |
| 8 | Requirements_Lists | 51 | 26.289 | [20.103, 32.474] | [20.598, 32.900] | 0.00% |
| 9 | User_Stories | 63 | 32.474 | [25.773, 39.175] | [26.280, 39.349] | 0.00% |
| 10 | Notebooks | 66 | 34.021 | [27.320, 40.722] | [27.722, 40.940] | 0.00% |

Joint bottom-two pair across replicates: **{BDD, MLCanvas} 97.55%**; then Vision+BDD 1.44%, Goal+BDD 0.89%. P(BDD is rank 1) = 99.95%; P(MLCanvas rank ≤ 2) = 98.46%. Observed gap from ML Canvas to rank 3 is 7.16 pp — the pair is well separated. Wilson and percentile agree throughout.

## Secondary: documenters-only base, N=146

| format | k | % | 95% bootstrap CI | P(in two least used) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **BDD_Scenarios** | 4 | **2.740** | [0.685, 5.479] | 100.00% |
| **MLCanvas** | 15 | **10.274** | [5.479, 15.068] | 97.91% |
| Vision_Document / Goal_Models | 29 | 19.863 | [13.699, 26.712] | 1.25% / 0.80% |

Same pair, {BDD, MLCanvas}, in 97.91% of replicates. ML Canvas moves from 7.73% → 10.27% between bases, as you anticipated.

## The substantive ambiguity, surfaced not smoothed

You flagged that Not_Documented enters the second-lowest slot at n=146. I tested it directly, and the cause is **not** the base — it is the exclusion rule:

- N=194, named-only set → bottom two: BDD 2.06% + ML Canvas 7.73%. N=194, all-12 set → **identical**: BDD 2.06% + ML Canvas 7.73%.
- N=146, named-only set → BDD 2.74% + ML Canvas 10.27%. N=146, **all-12** set → BDD 2.74% + **Not_Documented 4.11%**.

So **the candidate pair is {BDD scenarios, ML Canvas} on both bases**, and it flips to {BDD scenarios, Not_Documented} only under one specific conjunction: the narrow n=146 base *and* treating "Not_Documented" as a documentation format. I reject that conjunction on instrument grounds — Not_Documented is the "none of the above" option, and 24 of its 30 endorsers quoted no format at all, which is what a none-option looks like, not a medium. I report it rather than burying it, because it is the single reading under which the answer changes.

## Denominator / exclusion sensitivity (audit trail)

| base | N | lowest | second | ML Canvas | BDD | Not_Documented | Others |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| all respondents | 276 | BDD 1.45% | MLCanvas 5.43% | 5.435 | 1.449 | 10.870 | 5.435 |
| **Q10-complete (primary)** | **194** | BDD 2.06% | MLCanvas 7.73% | 7.732 | 2.062 | 15.464 | 7.732 |
| Q10-complete, Completed only | 164 | BDD 2.44% | MLCanvas 8.54% | 8.537 | 2.439 | 15.244 | 8.537 |
| Q10-complete, Completed+break | 188 | BDD 2.13% | MLCanvas 7.98% | 7.979 | 2.128 | 15.426 | 7.979 |
| documenters-only (secondary) | 146 | BDD 2.74% | NotDoc 4.11%* | 10.274 | 2.740 | 4.110 | 7.534 |

\*second place in the *all-12* set; in the named-only set it is ML Canvas at 10.27%. **{BDD, ML Canvas} is the named-format pair in all five bases.**

## Limitations

1. **Reference figures are not reproduced.** 10.13%/4.366% cannot be produced from this file: no denominator in [40,1500] yields both, and their ratio 2.3202 is not the ratio of any pair of observed counts {4,15,15,29,29,30,34,38,42,51,63,66}. Stated once, plainly — no tuning was done toward them.
2. **The quoted CIs are not attainable at this sample size.** ±0.204 pp and ±0.135 pp imply n≈84,500 and 88,000; the binomial 95% half-widths at n=194 are ±4.25 pp and ±2.88 pp. They look like SE/√B, not a CI for a proportion. My intervals are ~20× wider because they are honest.
3. **The dichotomized reading is an assumption, not a confirmed fact.** This CSV codes Q10 only as `quoted`/`not quoted`/`-77`. If the original instrument carried a usage-degree scale, my metric cannot express it, and a mean-Likert reading was never computable here.
4. **BDD small-count caveat, explicit:** k=4 of 194. One tick = 0.515 pp, so the nearest attainable values are 1.546 / 2.062 / 2.577% — the bootstrap distribution is coarse and discrete and its 0.515% lower bound is one-tick granularity, not continuous precision. Rank 1 for BDD is qualitatively solid (P=99.95%) but the *magnitude* rests on four responses.
5. Pair frequency is seed-stable (97.38–97.92% across seeds 0/7/42/2024).
6. The 82 excluded respondents are all `Suspended`; item non-response cannot be verified as random w.r.t. format choice. Multiple-response shares sum to >100% and are marginal rates, not a partition.

payload.final_answer: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are BDD scenarios and ML Canvas. On the primary Q10-complete base (N=194 respondents; 276 total minus 82 whole-block no-response records), BDD scenarios were used by 2.06% (95% bootstrap CI 0.52-4.12) and ML Canvas by 7.73% (95% CI 4.12-11.86), versus 14.95% or more for every other named format; the pair is jointly the two least used in 97.6% of 10,000 respondent-level bootstrap replicates (seed 42). On the secondary documenters-only base (N=146) the same two formats still rank lowest, at 2.74% (95% CI 0.69-5.48) for BDD scenarios and 10.27% (95% CI 5.48-15.07) for ML Canvas. The result is stable across five denominators (N=276, 194, 188, 164, 146). These are computed values; the study's 10.13% / 4.366% figures and their quoted confidence intervals are not reproducible from this data file and are not claimed as reproduced.
payload.hypothesis: BDD scenarios and ML Canvas are the two least-used requirements-documentation formats in ML-enabled system projects. On the Q10-complete base (N=194 respondents after excluding 82 whole-block -77 no-response records from 276), BDD scenarios are quoted by 2.06% (95% bootstrap CI 0.515-4.124) and ML Canvas by 7.73% (95% CI 4.124-11.856), against >=14.9% for all other named formats. On the secondary documenters-only base (N=146) the same two remain the lowest at 2.74% (0.685-5.479) and 10.274% (5.479-15.068). The pair is jointly bottom-two in 97.6% (N=194) and 97.9% (N=146) of 10,000 respondent-level bootstrap replicates (seed 42).
payload.workflow: 1) Load CSV with dtype=str so -77/-99/-66 sentinels are never coerced. 2) Verify -77 is a whole-block skip (82 rows, all Suspended, zero partial skips) -> NaN, excluded from numerator and denominator, N=194. 3) Q10 recoded as binary multiple-response (quoted/not quoted); mean-Likert reading not computable. 4) Rank the 10 named formats by marginal selection proportion; exclude Not_Documented (none-of-the-above) and free-text Others (heterogeneous residual), both retained in an auditable sensitivity table. 5) Respondent-level bootstrap B=10000 seed=42; 95% percentile CI plus Wilson sensitivity; ranking computed as a joint statistic per replicate to give P(format in two least used) and bottom-two pair frequency. 6) Secondary documenters-only base N=146 run identically and reported alongside. 7) Addenda: named-only vs all-12 candidate-pair test, BDD small-count discreteness, seed stability, rank-3 separation, denominator sensitivity across 5 bases, and the non-reproduction / CI-impossibility diagnostic for the reference figures.
